acceptance_predicates.description: A fresh disposable user can initialize a project, install each supported tool kind, discover inventory, select a generated catalog, and run a benchmark.
Configuration, catalog provenance, and results are present in the project and contain no secret values.
Repeat, interruption, missing, stale, unsafe, and incompatible cases are actionable and do not corrupt state.
Every new command has understandable human output and equivalent `--json` evidence.

definition_of_done: Fresh-user end-to-end receipt, applicable locked gates, and exact post-merge CI pass

inputs.description: AR-1760 through AR-1764 merged implementation and test contracts.

gates.description: The complete disposable project journey passes for all supported tool classes.
No real credential, token, private host path, or production-only validation is required.
